description: YONGIN, Gyeonggi Province — On an unfinished floor of SK hynix's new memory-chip plant, space is being set aside for companies struggling to get their equipment and materials approved for use in major semiconductor factories. When reporters visited on Nov. 10, protective sheets covered the floor and construction lifts stood where equipment will arrive next year.
